verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents audit logging of authentication or admin activity, tamper-evidence, or any streaming or export path to a SIEM. Auth hooks at lifecycle points and refresh-token reuse detection are adjacent building blocks, not an audit-log capability. Audit logging is a fair axis for an auth product, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can capture tamper-evident audit logs of authentication and admin activity and stream or export them to my SIEM
